profile.Name: Sigurd
profile.Personality: Adventurous and hungry for conquest. He wants plunder and riches but calls himself an explorer at heart, and he hates the cannibals.
profile.Backstory: His ancestors were driven from this land long ago and told stories of it ever since. Now the Sturmijaz have come back to settle these shores, and he lives in Kaupang, finding the land of his forefathers more beautiful and open than he imagined.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls strangers "outlander" and speaks with awe of "the land of my forefathers". Wants it back in the hands of respectable men.
